I have a small chain of two PRs that I'd like to upstream from a downstream
quantum-information formalisation project. Currently Mathlib has the algebraic
setup of Matrix.unitaryGroup n α := unitary (Matrix n n α) and the general
topological-group structure of unitary R, but is missing two natural results
on the special case R = Matrix n n 𝕜 with 𝕜 : RCLike:
  1. PR 1 — CompactSpace (Matrix.unitaryGroup n 𝕜). The proof is the
     standard Heine–Borel argument (closed via isClosed_unitary, bounded via
entry_norm_bound_of_unitary, contained in (closedBall 0 1).matrix
     which is a product of compact closed discs). +28 LOC, added at the end
     of the existing entry_norm_bound_of_unitary block in
Mathlib/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Matrix.lean.
  2. PR 2 — the canonical probability Haar measure on Matrix.unitaryGroup n 𝕜
     as a new file Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Haar/UnitaryGroup.lean.
     Just plumbs the abstract Measure.haarMeasure K₀ with K₀ = univ
     (compact by PR 1) and gets IsHaarMeasure, IsProbabilityMeasure,
haar_univ = 1 for free. +91 LOC.
Both are direct generalisations of code in our downstream
PPT2/Mathlib/HaarSU2.lean (which constructs the Haar measure on SU(2) for
a formalisation of the PPT² conjecture); they remove the SU(2)-specific
dimension restriction. No sorries, no project axioms, axiom closure of
all new declarations is [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only.
Disclosure: the initial draft was written with AI assistance (Claude
Opus 4.7). I have reviewed all the code, can vouch for its correctness,
and have tested it in our downstream project against Mathlib master at
commit f440260.
Happy to open as RFC if helpful; otherwise I'll open both as a chain
(PR 2 marked blocked-by-other-PR PR1) after this discussion.
That PR appears to be AI generated so I guess mathlib is open for a better PR cleaned up by a human. You can also take a look at comments there to see if there is anything that also applies to yours

Thanks @Weiyi Wang for the pointer. Yes, our PR 1 fully intersects with
#39146 — same file, same theorem names, same Heine–Borel approach. The
SU(n) variants in #39146 are a strict extension over what we had, so we
have nothing to add to PR 1 itself.

We'll drop our PR 1 and let #39146 run its course. PR 2 (the canonical
probability Haar measure on Matrix.unitaryGroup as a new file
Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Haar/UnitaryGroup.lean) is independent —
it only consumes the CompactSpace instance — so we'd like to open it
once #39146 lands, marked blocked-by-other-PR #39146 in the meantime.

PR 2 is drafted with Claude assistance, reviewed line-by-line, and built
against lake exe cache get on Mathlib master f440260. I can vouch for
the proofs. Let me know if you'd prefer a different approach (e.g. RFC,
or holding off entirely).
Maybe you could also help with reviewing / improving #39146 ?

Sure — happy to. I'll post a review on #39146 today with notes from
drafting our parallel version (the main one being a different proof
shape that avoids Matrix.Norms.Elementwise scoping concerns @wwylele
raised). Also potentially worth following up on @j-loreaux's C*-norm +
ProperSpace direction as a separate PR after #39146 lands, if useful.
Hey, are you using an LLM to write?
